description: Pivoted to deepfake detection: its TTS/voice models (incl. Chatterbox) are 'no longer offered as commercial paid products' and it stopped taking new TTS customers (2026-08-13 announcement); existing customers are still supported, with no published shutdown date. Resemble still publishes the Chatterbox TTS family as MIT-licensed open weights, listed below. Since 2026-04-29 its remaining hosted TTS ("Resemble Ultra") is powered by xAI rather than a Resemble model (resemble.ai changelog), and its pricing page lists only detection and security plans.
name: Resemble AI
